G1900.et: from (1909) and (the accusative case plural neuter of) (1565)
G1900.def: from «1909» and (the accusative case plural neuter of) «1565»; upon those parts of, i.e. on the further side of:--beyond.

G1901.def: middle voice from «1909» and «1614»; to stretch (oneself) forward upon:--reach forth.

G1902.def: middle voice from «1909» and «1746»; to invest upon oneself:--be clothed upon.

G1903.def: from «1902»; a wrapper, i.e. outer garment:--fisher's coat.

G1904.def: from «1909» and «2064»; to supervene, i.e. arrive, occur, impend, attack, (figuratively) influence:--come (in, upon).

G1905.def: from «1909» and «2065»; to ask for, i.e. inquire, seek:--ask (after, questions), demand, desire, question.

G1907.def: from «1909» and «2192»; to hold upon, i.e. (by implication) to retain; (by extension) to detain; (with implication, of «3563») to pay attention to:--give (take) heed unto, hold forth, mark, stay.

G1908.et: from a comparative of (1909) and (probably) areia (threats)
G1908.def: from a comparative of «1909» and (probably) areia (threats); to insult, slander:--use despitefully, falsely accuse.

G1909.def: a primary preposition; properly, meaning superimposition (of time, place, order, etc.), as a relation of distribution (with the genitive case), i.e. over, upon, etc.; of rest (with the dative case) at, on, etc.; of direction (with the accusative case) towards, upon, etc.:--about (the times), above, after, against, among, as long as (touching), at, beside, × have charge of, (be-, (where-))fore, in (a place, as much as, the time of, -to), (because) of, (up-)on (behalf of), over, (by, for) the space of, through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), with. In compounds it retains essentially the same import, at, upon, etc. (literally or figuratively).

G1910.def: from «1909» and the base of «939»; to walk upon, i.e. mount, ascend, embark, arrive:--come (into), enter into, go abroad, sit upon, take ship.

G1911.def: from «1909» and «906»; to throw upon (literal or figurative, transitive or reflexive; usually with more or less force); specially (with «1438» implied) to reflect; impersonally, to belong to:--beat into, cast (up-)on, fall, lay (on), put (unto), stretch forth, think on.

G1912.def: from «1909» and «916»; to be heavy upon, i.e. (pecuniarily) to be expensive to; figuratively, to be severe towards:--be chargeable to, overcharge.

G1913.et: from (1909) and a redupl. deriv. of the base of (939) [cf (307)]
G1913.def: from «1909» and a reduplicated derivative of the base of «939» (compare «307»); to cause to mount (an animal):--set on.

G1914.def: from «1909» and «991»; to gaze at (with favor, pity or partiality):--look upon, regard, have respect to.

G1917.et: from a presumed compound of (1909) and (1014)
G1917.def: from a presumed compound of «1909» and «1014»; a plan against someone, i.e. a plot:--laying (lying) in wait.

G1918.def: from «1909» and a derivative of «1062»; to form affinity with, i.e. (specially) in a levirate way:--marry.

G1919.def: from «1909» and «1093»; worldly (physically or morally):--earthly, in earth, terrestrial.

G1920.def: from «1909» and «1096»; to arrive upon, i.e. spring up (as a wind):--blow.

G1921.def: from «1909» and «1097»; to know upon some mark, i.e. recognize; by implication, to become fully acquainted with, to acknowledge:--(ac-, have, take)know(-ledge, well), perceive.

G1922.def: from «1921»; recognition, i.e. (by implication) full discernment, acknowledgement:--(ac-)knowledge(-ing, - ment).

G1924.def: from «1909» and «1125»; to inscribe (physically or mentally):--inscription, write in (over, thereon).

G1925.def: from «1909» and «1166»; to exhibit (physically or mentally):--shew.

G1926.def: from «1909» and «1209»; to admit (as a guest or (figuratively) teacher):--receive.

G1927.def: from a compound of «1909» and «1218»; to make oneself at home, i.e. (by extension) to reside (in a foreign country):--(be) dwelling (which were) there, stranger.

G1928.def: middle voice from «1909» and «1299»; to appoint besides, i.e. supplement (as a codicil):--add to.

G1929.def: from «1909» and «1325»; to give over (by hand or surrender):--deliver unto, give, let (+ (her drive)), offer.

G1930.def: from «1909» and a derivative of «3717»; to straighten further, i.e. (figuratively) arrange additionally:--set in order.

G1931.def: from «1909» and «1416»; to set fully (as the sun):--go down.

G1932.def: from «1933»; suitableness, i.e. (by implication) equity, mildness:--clemency, gentleness.

G1933.def: from «1909» and «1503»; appropriate, i.e. (by implication) mild:--gentle, moderation, patient.

G1934.def: from «1909» and «2212»; to search (inquire) for; intensively, to demand, to crave:--desire, enquire, seek (after, for).

G1935.def: from «1909» and «2288»; doomed to death:--appointed to death.

G1936.def: from «2007»; an imposition (of hands officially):--laying (putting) on.

G1937.def: from «1909» and «2372»; to set the heart upon, i.e. long for (rightfully or otherwise):--covet, desire, would fain, lust (after).

G1939.def: from «1937»; a longing (especially for what is forbidden):--concupiscence, desire, lust (after).

G1940.def: from «1909» and «2523»; to seat upon:--set on.

G1941.def: middle voice from «1909» and «2564»; to entitle; by implication, to invoke (for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.):--appeal (unto), call (on, upon), surname.

G1943.def: from «1909» and «2572»; to conceal, i.e. (figuratively) forgive:--cover.

G1944.def: from «1909» and a derivative of «2672»; imprecated, i.e. execrable:--accursed.

G1945.def: from «1909» and «2749»; to rest upon (literally or figuratively):--impose, be instant, (be) laid (there-, up-)on, (when) lay (on), lie (on), press upon.

G1946.def: from Epikouros (compare «1947») (a noted philosopher); an Epicurean or follower of Epicurus:--Epicurean.

G1947.et: from a compound of (1909) and a (prolonged) form of the base of (2877) (in the sense of servant)
G1947.def: from a compound of «1909» and a (prolonged) form of the base of «2877» (in the sense of servant); assistance:--help.

G1949.def: middle voice from «1909» and «2983»; to seize (for help, injury, attainment, or any other purpose; literally or figuratively):--catch, lay hold (up-)on, take (by, hold of, on).

G1950.def: middle voice from «1909» and «2990»; to lose out of mind; by implication, to neglect:--(be) forget(-ful of).

G1951.def: middle voice from «1909» and «3004»; to surname, select:--call, choose.

G1952.def: from «1909» and «3007»; to leave upon, i.e. (figuratively) to be insufficient for:--fail.

G1953.def: from a derivative of «1950»; negligence:--X forgetful.

G1954.def: from «1909» and «3062»; left over, i.e. remaining:--rest.

G1956.def: from «1909» and «3089»; to solve further, i.e. (figuratively) to explain, decide:--determine, expound.

G1957.def: from «1909» and «3140»; to attest further, i.e. corroborate:--testify.

G1958.def: from «1959»; carefulness, i.e. kind attention (hospitality):--+ refresh self.

G1959.et: middle voice from (1909) and the same as (3199)
G1959.def: middle voice from «1909» and the same as «3199»; to care for (physically or otherwise):--take care of.

G1960.def: adverb from a derivative of «1959»; carefully:--diligently.

G1961.def: from «1909» and «3306»; to stay over, i.e. remain (figuratively, persevere):--abide (in), continue (in), tarry.

G1962.def: from «1909» and «3506»; to nod at, i.e. (by implication) to assent:--consent.

G1963.def: from «1909» and «3563»; attention of the mind, i.e. (by implication) purpose:--thought.

G1965.def: from «1909» and «3727»; on oath, i.e. (falsely) a forswearer:--perjured person.

G1966.pos:
1. to come upon, approach
    1. of time, to come on, be at hand, next, following, on the following day
G1966.et: feminine singular participle of a comparative of (1909) and heimi (to go)
G1966.def: feminine singular participle of a comparative of «1909» and heimi (to go); supervening, i.e. (2250 or «3571» being expressed or implied) the ensuing day or night:--following, next.

G1967.def: perhaps from the same as «1966»; tomorrow's; but more probably from «1909» and a derivative of the present participle feminine of «1510»; for subsistence, i.e. needful:--daily.

G1968.def: from «1909» and «4098»; to embrace (with affection) or seize (with more or less violence; literally or figuratively):--fall into (on, upon) lie on, press upon.

G1969.def: from «1909» and «4141»; to chastise, i.e. (with words) to upbraid:--rebuke.

G1970.pos: 1. to throttle upon, to overgrow, to choke
G1970.def: from «1909» and «4155»; to throttle upon, i.e. (figuratively) overgrow:--choke.

G1971.def: from «1909» and potheo (to yearn); to dote upon, i.e. intensely crave possession (lawfully or wrongfully):--(earnestly) desire (greatly), (greatly) long (after), lust.

G1973.et: from (1909) and a derivative of the latter part of (1971)
G1973.def: from «1909» and a derivative of the latter part of «1971»; yearned upon, i.e. greatly loved:--longed foreign

G1975.def: from «1909» and «4198»; to journey further, i.e. travel on (reach):--come.

G1976.def: from «1909» and the base of «4476»; to stitch upon, i.e. fasten with the needle:--sew on.

G1977.def: from «1909» and «4496»; to throw upon (literally or figuratively):--cast upon.

G1978.et: from (1909) and some form of the base of (4591)
G1978.def: from «1909» and some form of the base of «4591»; remarkable, i.e. (figuratively) eminent:--notable, of note.

G1979.et: from a compound of (1909) and a derivative of (4621)
G1979.def: from a compound of «1909» and a derivative of «4621»; a provisioning, i.e. (concretely) food:--victuals.

G1980.et: middle voice from (1909) and the base of (4649)
G1980.def: middle voice from «1909» and the base of «4649»; to inspect, i.e. (by implication) to select; by extension, to go to see, relieve:--look out, visit.

G1981.def: from «1909» and «4637»; to tent upon, i.e. (figuratively) abide with :--rest upon.

G1982.def: from «1909» and a derivative of «4639»; to cast a shade upon, i.e. (by analogy) to envelop in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively, to invest with preternatural influence:--overshadow.

G1983.def: from «1909» and «4648»; to oversee; by implication, to beware:--look diligently, take the oversight.

G1984.def: from «1980»; inspection (for relief); by implication, superintendence; specially, the Christian "episcopate":--the office of a "bishop", bishoprick, visitation.

G1985.def: from «1909» and «4649» (in the sense of «1983»); a superintendent, i.e. Christian officer in genitive case charge of a (or the) church (literally or figuratively):--bishop, overseer.

G1986.def: from «1909» and «4685»; to draw over, i.e. (with «203» implied) efface the mark of circumcision (by recovering with the foreskin):--become uncircumcised.

G1987.et: apparently a middle voice of (2186) (with (3563) implied)
G1987.def: apparently a middle voice of «2186» (with «3563» implied); to put the mind upon, i.e. comprehend, or be acquainted with:--know, understand.

G1988.et: from (1909) and a presumed derivative of (2476)
G1988.def: from «1909» and a presumed derivative of «2476»; an appointee over, i.e. commander (teacher):--master.

G1989.def: from «1909» and «4724»; to enjoin (by writing), i.e. (genitive case) to communicate by letter (for any purpose):--write (a letter, unto).

G1991.def: from «1909» and «4741»; to support further, i.e. reestablish:--confirm, strengthen.

G1993.def: from «1909» and «4750»; to put something over the mouth, i.e. (figuratively) to silence:--stop mouths.

G1994.def: from «1909» and «4762»; to revert (literally, figuratively or morally):--come (go) again, convert, (re-)turn (about, again).

G1996.def: from «1909» and «4863»; to collect upon the same place:--gather (together).

G1997.def: from «1996»; a complete collection; especially a Christian meeting (for worship):--assembling (gathering) together.

G1998.def: from «1909» and «4936»; to hasten together upon one place (or a particular occasion):--come running together.

G1999.et: from the middle voice of a compound of (1909) and (4921)
G1999.def: from the middle voice of a compound of «1909» and «4921»; a conspiracy, i.e. concourse (riotous or friendly):--that which cometh upon, + raising up.
